# HR & Admin Payroll and Policy Review

This document details critical action items for the Human Resources & Administration department.

## Action Items:

*   Monitor medical insurance based on audit requirements.
*   Investigate the bonus structure on a quarterly basis.
*   Optimize career development programs quarterly.
*   Update the annual leave standard.
*   Investigate and update the bonus structure standard.
